title: Magnets
info: A magnet pulls on some metals, especially iron and steel.
Every magnet has a north pole and a south pole. Opposite poles attract. The same poles push apart.

questions.q: Which object will a magnet usually attract?
Which metal is not attracted to a typical magnet?
questions.explain: Aluminum is a metal, but it is not magnetic like iron and steel.
